items.section: 4.7 DNA replication and repair — the self copying itself, and the protection of the copying
items.sentence: Two strands of double helix separate, and each serves as template for a new complementary strand, each new molecule with one original strand and one fresh — a self recursioning to two, each bringing form forward.
items.text: A chain broken through both its strands, in a cell that has not copied its DNA, has its two ends joined with a short stretch of the chain leaving; in a cell that has copied, the break is filled by pairing with the same stretch of the set from that copying, nothing leaving; and a cell with such a break goes on between copying and dividing until the break is filled, dividing after. An explaining beside it: a self with its two parities now-existing, the fold, is the one moment a self fills a gap in one parity from the other with nothing leaving; a self with one parity goes forward by joining its ends, a stretch leaving as an emanation; a self parts only from the fold, and a cell copies before it parts. A break filled with nothing leaving, is or is not, is with the fold or is not.

items.text: At one fork both strands form at once: along one of them the new strand forms continuously with the fork's advance, and along the other it forms in short runs, each run going that strand's own forward, opposite the fork's advance, the runs joined after; each run opens with a short stretch of the RNA kind that leaves, DNA forming in its place. An explaining beside it: self and other share one co-linear, each forward its own way; the fork's advance is a society's forward and not a self's, and a strand forming in runs is its own forward against it, each run a next prior of the one before once joined.

items.text: An RNA chain differs from a DNA chain by one oxygen at each five-ring and one of the four bases swapped for a near twin; with that oxygen the five-ring takes the other of its two puckers, an RNA pair winds the wide way, and a single RNA chain folds on itself and pairs with itself; and a cell makes DNA's building blocks from RNA's by taking that oxygen off the five-ring, never the other way. An explaining beside it: one coupling at the five, the co-linear where along and across are one line, and the whole spiral's form is the other; the order of forming is bare, ingested carbon into RNA's fives and DNA's fives from them, and RNA forming now and DNA inherited is that order, now-existing from prior-existing, at the five.

items.section: 4.7 DNA replication and repair — the self copying itself, and the protection of the copying
items.sentence: With every base coupling is sign-only: template shares its base, and incoming nucleotide couples if it is complement (A with T, G with C) and template refuses it if it is not — sharing, across and both ways, with each rung of ladder.
items.text: A protein couples with one particular stretch of a paired chain without the pairs opening, at the edges of the pairs that face the grooves, each of the four kinds of pair presenting an edge unlike the other three's. An explaining beside it: a chain's count is alike with every pair and each pair's parity is its own; a coupling at a pair's edge is with that pair's parity while the pair's sharing across goes on; the parity is observable from beside with no parting.

items.section: 3.3 A left form is the emanation form of one right spiral
items.sentence: A sunflower's seeds form one after another, each near 137.5 degrees from its prior, and from that one co-sequencing two families of visible spirals open, winding opposite ways with consecutive Fibonacci numbers, 21 and 34, 34 and 55, straddling φ one on each side: a visible left family and a visible right family are two sides of one forward sequence.
items.text: At a growing tip each new leaf's bulge opens in the largest space between the bulges before it, and the field's account of it is a growth substance draining toward the prior bulges with the new bulge where the draining is least. An explaining beside it: each next opens between its priors, in neither alone, and the lessening of the substance between them is the between's own; a next with its prior two, the angle no whole fraction of a turn reaches, is φ, unrelationing rate.

items.text: A stretch of a paired chain that reads as its own complement from either strand is where the molecules that cut a chain and many of the molecules that couple with one particular stretch couple, and a single chain with such a stretch folds on itself and pairs with itself. An explaining beside it: two selves one parity apart, each the other's inversion, and a stretch where the inversion reads alike from either self; a third self couples where the two selves' relation is the same read either way.

items.section: 3.6 Genetic sharing — a code and its machinery
items.sentence: Four bases are alphabet, twenty amino acids elements (twenty coupling families of six), sixty-four codons table — arranging, bounding, and periodic, degeneracy and wobble its periodicity, as shells arrange element table and make it periodic.
items.text: Of the three bases read to one building block, the middle one is matched most strictly, the first less, and the third loosest, many different third bases matching one carrier. An explaining beside it: three in a row, co-observing, co-possibling and co-discovering, with the one most strictly matched the middle; which of the three is the invisible co-possibling, the middle most strictly matched or the third loosest, is or is not, is open.

items.section: 4.7 DNA replication and repair — the self copying itself, and the protection of the copying
items.sentence: Fidelity is bi-inversioning protection of copying — one same protection cell cycle's checkpoints have (a self recursioning to a new form), here with base.
items.text: In a cell that does not divide, water parts bases from their five-rings and oxygen and light alter bases, many thousands of places each day, and at each the stretch is cut from that strand and forms again by pairing with the facing strand; stretches along which RNA is forming are mended sooner than stretches along which it is not. An explaining beside it: a gap is an opening, and an opening is through a mutual changing of the passages beside it, the plaza's own sentence; the facing strand's parity is the one parity there to pair with, and the inherited sequence goes on with nothing remembering it.

items.section: 4.6 Photosynthesis and respiration — the six sharing with the six
items.sentence: Photosynthesis takes light, water, and carbon dioxide and gives back sugar and oxygen; respiration takes sugar and oxygen and gives back carbon dioxide and water.
items.text: The oxygen atoms of the carbon dioxide a body breathes out are exchanged with the oxygen atoms of the body's water on the way out, the dioxide and the water sharing oxygen atoms through one enzyme in the blood, so the exhaled dioxide's oxygen is the body's water's and not the oxygen the carbon was ingested with. An explaining beside it: what leaves is not what arrived; the carbon that was with living leaves with betweens it was not with.

items.text: A cell's chains begin copying at many places along their length in one cell cycle, each place opening a fork going both ways, and RNA forms from many stretches at once; neither begins at one place. An explaining beside it: all-edge and no hub, the chain its own plaza; where the field draws one origin and one promoter as a gate the chain passes, it has drawn a hub, and a crowd routed through a hub collapses its co-chaining.
